title: Финальный Босс: 4 Времени (Викторина)
description: Выбери правильное время из 4: Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect, Present Perfect.

items.question: I ___ my keys! I can't find them. (lose)
items.answerSentence: I have lost my keys! I can't find them.

items.question: I ___ my keys before I left home. (lose)
items.answerSentence: I had lost my keys before I left home.

items.question: I ___ for my keys when the phone rang. (look)
items.answerSentence: I was looking for my keys when the phone rang.

items.question: By the time the police ___ , the thief (escape).
items.answerSentence: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.

items.question: By the time the police (arrive), the thief ___.
items.answerSentence: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.

items.question: I ___ never ___ such a beautiful place before I visited Paris. (see)
items.answerSentence: I had never seen such a beautiful place before I visited Paris.

items.question: While I ___ home, it started to rain. (walk)
items.answerSentence: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
